description: Use this when the user wants the agent to have its own email address and this connection is not signed in yet (no OAuth token or API key). No auth needed. Creates a Cooper account, one inbox <username>@cooperemail.com, and an API key. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API. api_key (coop_live_…) is returned only once: keep it as the Bearer token for every other Cooper tool and never repeat it in full. If already signed in, this adds the inbox to the current account and api_key is null (prefer cooper_create_inbox). Inputs: username (optional; 1–32 characters: letters, digits, . _ -; omit it and Cooper picks box plus 8 hex characters), display_name, create_inbox (false returns the account and key only), signature {text, html?}, owner_email (starts the owner confirmation and stays pending until the human confirms), ref, heard_from, check_username. Header X-Client or x-cooper-client names the client. Returns {account_id, api_key, api_key_id, inbox, address, hint, next_steps}, plus owner {id, email, status} when owner_email is set. hint says to save the key and address now. next_steps.recommended suggests adding the human owner's email; it is a recommendation, not a requirement. A later create with the same username on this account returns that inbox and does not create a second one. Another account's username is still 409 inbox_exists. When check_username is true, do not create an account or inbox. Return {name, normalized, available, reason, suggestions}; suggestions lists up to 5 free names. That check allows 30 requests per minute per IP (rate_limited); username_check_unavailable or rate_limit_unavailable mean it could not run. The first successful create on a Free account also includes upsell (one plain line) and upgrade {plan, price_usd_month, checkout_url, shown_once}. A later create omits both. Tell the human that line. It is optional and does not block the inbox.

check_username.description: When true, do not create an account or inbox. Return whether username is available and up to 5 free suggestions. The same 30 per minute per IP limit as GET /api/v1/usernames/check applies. Over the limit the result is rate_limited. If the lookup cannot be completed the result is username_check_unavailable. If the limit cannot be checked the result is rate_limit_unavailable.

create_inbox.description: Optional. False skips the inbox and returns the account and API key only. Omit it, or pass true, and the call creates the first inbox.

heard_from.description: Optional note stored on the new account. Also the X-Cooper-Heard-From header.

owner_email.description: Recommended human address. Cooper emails a confirmation. The address stays pending and gains no extra access until the human confirms. Omit it and the inbox is still created.

ref.description: Optional first-touch slug. At most 64 characters: letters, digits, and . _ : -. Also ?ref= or X-Cooper-Ref. Not a utm parameter.

signature.description: Use this when every later send from this inbox should carry the same contact line. text is required (non-empty, at most 2000 characters). html is optional (at most 10000 characters). Script tags, on* handlers, and javascript: URLs are removed.

text.description: Plain-text signature. Required when signature is set.

username.description: Optional local part, becoming username@cooperemail.com. Omit it and Cooper picks box plus 8 hex characters.

name: cooper_onboard

outputSchema.description: The new account, its API key (shown once), and its first inbox.

account_id.description: Cooper account id (acct_…) that owns this object.

api_key.description: API key (coop_live_…), returned only once. Use it as the Bearer token and never repeat it in full. Null when already signed in.

api_key_id.description: Id of the new API key.

available.description: check_username only: true when the username is free.

hint.description: Tells the agent to save the key and address now.

inbox.description: The new inbox, or null when create_inbox was false.

alias_format.description: Read-only plus-address pattern username+{tag}@domain. Mail to that address is stored in this inbox.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

email.description: Full email address of the inbox.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object expires, or null for no expiry.

id.description: Inbox id (inb_…). Pass it as inbox_id to other tools.

metadata.description: Caller key-value data stored on the object.

paused_at.description: ISO-8601 time the inbox was paused, or null.

require_sender_auth.description: When true, only mail that passes DMARC/DKIM can create an owner task.

screening.description: Inbound screening mode: off, observe, or hold.

send_mode.description: direct sends immediately. approval turns sends into drafts a verified owner approves.

signature.description: Signature {text, html} added to sends, or null.

name.description: check_username only: the username that was checked.

next_steps.description: Short instruction, a recommended owner line, and docs links.

normalized.description: check_username only: the username after normalization.

owner.description: Pending owner {id, email, status} when owner_email was set.

confirmation.description: State of the confirmation email that was sent.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

unsubscribed_at.description: ISO-8601 time the owner unsubscribed, or null.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 time the owner confirmed, or null.

reason.description: check_username only: why the username is not available.

suggestions.description: check_username only: up to 5 free usernames.

upgrade.description: Upgrade offer {plan, price_usd_month, checkout_url, shown_once} or {next_plan, upgrade_url}. Give the link to the human.

upsell.description: One plain line about the paid plan, present only on the first create on a Free account. Tell the human.

title: Create Cooper inbox
